{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I've put YEARS into searching for that payday, and I'll be rolled in bantha poodoo before I believe some no-talent freighter jockey beat me to the prize!|Vance Garlint's letter to the Voidhound|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vance Garlint''' was a treasure hunter during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who was obsessed with finding the lost treasure of [[Nok Drayen]]. Even after the [[Galactic Finders Guild]] officially verified the [[Voidhound]] as the treasure's locator, Garlint refused to believe it, and in an an angry letter called the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] names, and promised to continue searching for the "real" treasure.
